target_customer: 3PLs and fulfillment providers, distributors, manufacturers and brands running warehouses and transportation; also frontier AI labs buying RL environments
problem: Logistics operations make constrained planning decisions across WMS, TMS and ERP systems that generic LLMs handle poorly and legacy optimizers handle rigidly.
business_model: Enterprise software (planning and execution agents) plus data and RL environments for AI labs

founders.name: Jibran Hutchins
founders.background_notes: Founders say they published in IEEE and Elsevier Q1 journals on operations research and machine learning in high school.

founders.name: Joseph Tso
education: Princeton University, Computer Science (left to found)
founders.background_notes: A search snippet also names Preston Schmittou as a fourth founder; the YC page lists three.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining optimization solvers with LLM agents and integrating into WMS, TMS and ERP systems is demanding for a four person team.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integrations could create lock-in once deployed, but at founding no customers were named and the approach could be copied by funded logistics AI players.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too recent to know; no incumbent action found.

market_need_then: Warehouses and 3PLs spend heavily on operations and 2025 to 2026 coverage describes rising adoption of AI for operational decision loops; demand for RL environments from AI labs is also cited by the company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Serious, research flavored; tagline says the next frontier is judgement

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage with only YC launch and a few press pieces; no community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Haladir is an early stage Winter 2026 company that raised a 4.3M USD seed led by BoxGroup and Susa Ventures within months of Demo Day, and says it is working with a leading AI lab on post-training. It is too recent for a success or failure verdict; the open questions are customer adoption versus established warehouse software vendors and AI logistics startups.
notes: Seed amount appears in two outlets (4.3M USD) while one aggregator lists 4M. The round date is uncertain: one source says announced April 2026, the startuphub article was published 2026-07-14. No dated competitor sources from the batch period were found, so the list is empty. A news search for acquisition, layoffs or shutdown returned only unrelated results.
